request: 비가 어떻게 만들어지는지 보여주는 영상 만들어줘 lit
pathReason: The film has to draw clouds, droplets and the water cycle, not only words.
idea: A single droplet rides the whole water cycle, from a warm sea to a cloud and back down as rain.

beats.onScreen: a still sea under a low sun, one droplet blinking
the droplet lifts off the sea as heat lines rise
beats.motion: droplet floats up on a path, heat lines draw on

beats.onScreen: droplets gather into a swelling cloud
beats.motion: cloud morphs from small puffs to one mass

beats.onScreen: the cloud darkens and releases a sheet of rain
beats.motion: rain lines stagger down, match cut to the sea

beats.onScreen: the full cycle diagram with the droplet back home
beats.motion: diagram arrows draw around the loop

subject.name: Droplet Dot
specifics: a water droplet that travels the full cycle

typePlan.hierarchy: one headline per beat, small labels on the diagram

sound.plan: soft pulse with a rise into the lift and a hit on each cut

ambition: Match cuts that carry the droplet through every stage, with the diagram drawing itself in time with the pulse.
